data.turoyo: <...> W nafəqqe lak kalbanək w mtahthile m ḥḏoḏe. W mhalaxxe ʕam ḥḏoḏe hul ʕaṣriye.
data.translation: Er ging heraus gegen die Hunde und trieb sie auseinander. Und nun wanderten sie zusammen bis zum Abend.

rationale: Thin Preterit 1; contracted object-bearing form and explicit reciprocal separation complement.

summary: Keep stem I as the supplied glossary classifies this quadriliteral, despite the initial m-. No new Q label is inferred from general morphology.
The object may be a zero-marked dog NP, plural pronominal -i, or first-person -lan with fronted aḥna kulan. m ḥḏoḏe marks separation; b-briṯo marks dispersal through a domain. All remain sense 1.
The MAC Quzko /68 occurrence is the same recording passage already cited as 2018_07_06_au_005_MuA_Story_about_Quzko: 66–68, not an independent corroborating event.
